bullets.text: Firecracker incidents in Adambakkam and nearby areas destroyed eight vehicles and a house during Diwali celebrations, requiring the office to monitor safety fallout.
Anti-Narcotics Unit officials searched actor Balaji Murugadoss's residence in Thiruverkadu, prompting the office to watch for further developments in the public exchange.
Political leaders condemned the government after seventeen murders were reported across Tamil Nadu on Diwali, and the office should monitor opposition reactions.

stories.title: Chennai Firecracker Fires Destroy House, Eight Vehicles
takeaways: Firecracker fires destroyed a house and eight vehicles in Adambakkam, Sriperumbudur, and Poonamallee during Diwali.
Local authorities responded to multiple fire accidents with no reported human casualties.

stories.title: Narcotics officials search actor Balaji Murugadoss’s residence at Thiruverkadu
takeaways: The Anti-Narcotics Unit conducted a search at actor Balaji Murugadoss's Thiruverkadu apartment residence.
The police raid triggered a public exchange and media debate between the actor and authorities.

The major political attack puts immediate pressure on the governing party to address law and order.
